title: PRISM2
paper_title: End-to-End Multimodal Pathology Foundation Model with Clinical Dialogue
core_mech: PRISM2 明确提供双嵌入：Perceiver 的通用 base embedding，以及 Phi-3 隐状态导出的诊断 embedding。
core_mech_en: Pairs a Perceiver slide encoder over Virchow2 tile embeddings with a Phi-3 LLM trained on single-turn clinical dialogues derived from pathology reports, exposing dual embeddings.
input_desc: 一个病例的一张或多张 H&E WSI、文本提示与由报告改写的单轮临床对话
input_en: Multi-slide H&E case tile embeddings (Virchow2) + clinical prompt / diagnostic query
output_desc: 2560 维 base embedding、3072 维 diagnostic embedding、报告或问答文本
output_en: 2560-D base slide embedding, 3072-D LLM diagnostic embedding, or autoregressive pathology text response

source.title: PRISM2
notes: Only public model-card metadata was inspected. No gated files or pretrained weights were downloaded; code, weights and dataset terms must each be respected.
Hugging Face access is gated (manual). Each learner must obtain any required upstream access directly; this repository does not bypass gates.
Prism2's public gate terms additionally state that users may not distribute, publish or reproduce a copy of the model. Do not mirror weights.

gaps: PRISM2 public metadata is available, but its model access is gated and its terms restrict redistribution. No gated model files are mirrored and no local PRISM2 implementation is claimed.
